Ataste Privacy Policy

Last updated 14 October 2026

Ataste is an iPhone app that lets friends place a group order from the Atas Artisan bakery in Bali: it collects everyone's items, splits the bill, and writes the WhatsApp order the host sends to Atas. This policy explains what Ataste stores, why, who can see it, and how to delete it. Ataste is operated by Johar Kurniawan ("we"). Ataste is an independent app and is not affiliated with Atas Artisan.

WHAT WE COLLECT
- Your Apple user ID
    Where it comes from: Sign in with Apple
    Why: To sign you in. Apple gives Ataste an ID made for this app only. We never ask for or receive your email address.
- Your first name from Apple
    Where it comes from: Sign in with Apple, the first time, if you choose to share it
    Why: Only to suggest your name when you sign up
- Your WhatsApp phone number
    Where it comes from: Only if you verify it: the message you send from your own WhatsApp to our number
    Why: To show the Verified badge, to let you host group orders (Atas Artisan needs the host's number), and so your host can reach you on WhatsApp. You never type it.
- Your WhatsApp display name
    Where it comes from: The same message
    Why: Only to suggest a name in versions of Ataste before Sign in with Apple. It is deleted with the verification code within 24 hours.
- Your name
    Where it comes from: You type it
    Why: Shown to people in your groups and in the order message to Atas
- Groups, items, options, notes and splits
    Where it comes from: You enter them
    Why: To run the group order and work out each person's bill
- Payment method details (bank or e-wallet label, account name, account number)
    Where it comes from: You enter them, if you host
    Why: Shown to members of the groups you host so they can transfer to you
- Transfer receipt photos
    Where it comes from: You upload them
    Why: Visible to you and the host of that group, so the host can check your payment
- Delivery photos
    Where it comes from: Any group member uploads them
    Why: Visible to members of that group, as proof the order arrived
- Saved addresses and map links
    Where it comes from: You enter them
    Why: Used in the order message to Atas
- Push notification token
    Where it comes from: Your iPhone, if you allow notifications
    Why: To send you order updates

WHAT WE DON'T DO
- No advertising, no tracking across apps or websites, no analytics SDKs.
- We don't sell or rent your data, and we don't use it for anything other than running Ataste.
- Ataste does not process payments. You transfer money to the host yourself, outside the app.

WHO CAN SEE YOUR DATA
- People in the same group see your name, whether your number is verified, your phone number if you verified one (so the host can message you on WhatsApp), your items and your bill.
- The host of a group sees the transfer receipts of that group's members. Other members don't.
- Atas Artisan receives the order message the host chooses to send from their own WhatsApp. It contains the host's name and phone number, the delivery address, and each member's name and items.

SERVICE PROVIDERS
- Apple, for Sign in with Apple. Apple's privacy policy applies to your Apple ID.
- Supabase (database, sign-in and photo storage; servers in Tokyo, Japan).
- A server we rent in Singapore (OVH) that receives the WhatsApp verification messages sent to our number and refreshes the Atas Artisan menu. Verification codes and the phone number they came from are deleted within 24 hours.
- Apple Push Notification service, to deliver notifications.
- WhatsApp (Meta), if you send the verification message, and when a host sends an order. WhatsApp's own privacy policy applies to those messages.

HOW LONG WE KEEP IT

Your data stays until you delete your account. Verification codes are deleted within 24 hours. Transfer receipts and delivery photos are deleted 7 days after upload. Order history stays so your group can see past orders and bills.

DELETING YOUR ACCOUNT

In Ataste, go to Profile, then Delete account. This permanently deletes your profile, your phone number, your items and bills, your payment methods and addresses, and the receipts and delivery photos you uploaded, and disconnects your Apple ID from Ataste. Groups you host are deleted for all their members. You can also ask us to delete your account by writing to the address below.

CHILDREN

Ataste is not meant for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their data.

CHANGES

If we change this policy we will update the date above and, for important changes, tell you in the app.

CONTACT

Questions or requests: bayu.johar25@gmail.com

Ataste is an independent app and is not affiliated with Atas Artisan.
terms:
Ataste Terms of Use

Last updated 14 October 2026

These terms apply when you use the Ataste iPhone app, operated by Johar Kurniawan ("we"). By using Ataste you agree to them.

WHAT ATASTE DOES

Ataste helps a group of friends put together one order from Atas Artisan: members add items, the app splits the bill and writes the WhatsApp message, and the host sends that message to Atas Artisan from their own WhatsApp.

NOT AFFILIATED WITH ATAS ARTISAN

Ataste is an independent app. It is not made, endorsed or operated by Atas Artisan. Orders are placed directly between the host and Atas Artisan; Atas Artisan's prices, stock, delivery areas, cut-off times and policies apply. The menu in Ataste is copied from Atas Artisan's public website and may be out of date; Atas Artisan's confirmation is what counts.

PAYMENTS

Ataste does not take, hold or transfer money. Members pay the host directly, by bank transfer or e-wallet, outside the app. The host pays Atas Artisan. "Paid" marks in the app are records between you and your host, not payment confirmations by us. We are not responsible for disputes about money between members, hosts and Atas Artisan.

YOUR ACCOUNT

You sign in with Apple. You can also verify your WhatsApp number by sending a code from your own WhatsApp: it earns the Verified badge, and you need it to host a group order. The badge only means the number on the account is yours; it says nothing about bank accounts or payments. Keep your Apple ID and your phone secure. You are responsible for what happens in your account.

ACCEPTABLE USE
- Only add orders you mean to pay for, and only invite people who want to join.
- Don't upload photos that are offensive, illegal, or not about the order. Any member can report a delivery photo; reported photos are hidden and reviewed.
- Don't misuse the service, try to access other people's data, or interfere with its operation.

We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

AVAILABILITY

We provide Ataste as is. It may be unavailable at times, and features may change. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses, missed orders, or delivery problems.

ENDING YOUR USE

You can stop using Ataste and delete your account at any time from Profile, Delete account.

CHANGES AND LAW

We may update these terms; we will change the date above and tell you in the app about important changes. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.

CONTACT

bayu.johar25@gmail.com

Ataste is an independent app and is not affiliated with Atas Artisan.
support:
Ataste Support

Last updated 14 October 2026

Need help with Ataste? Write to bayu.johar25@gmail.com and we will reply within two working days.

COMMON QUESTIONS
- How do I sign in? Tap Sign in with Apple.
- What is the Verified badge? It shows that the WhatsApp number on an account belongs to that person. To get it, go to Profile and tap Verify with WhatsApp: WhatsApp opens with a short code already typed; press send. Ataste reads your number from that message. You need it to host a group order.
- My code expired. Codes last 10 minutes. Tap Send new code for a fresh one.
- I used Ataste before Sign in with Apple. Sign in with Apple, then verify the same WhatsApp number: Ataste offers to continue as your old account, with its groups and history.
- How do I join a friend's group? Open the link your host shared. If it opens in Safari, copy it, then in Ataste tap Paste a join link.
- Who sends the order to Atas Artisan? The host, from their own WhatsApp, using the message Ataste writes.
- How is ongkir split? Equally between everyone who ordered, after the host enters the amount Atas Artisan confirms.
- How do I delete my account? Profile, then Delete account.

NOT AFFILIATED

Ataste is not affiliated with Atas Artisan. For questions about products, prices or deliveries, contact Atas Artisan directly.

Ataste is an independent app and is not affiliated with Atas Artisan.
